data.narrative:
Harmattan AI, a Series B defense and security frontier-tech company, is valued at $1.4B post-money following $200M in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar or adjacent stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $1.4B last post-money valuation, applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage step-ups, implying a forward valuation of $2.7B. Peer-median benchmarking across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. Sample peers include Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Twenty ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M to $3.1B, with a median cross-method estimate of $1.8B. The current $1.4B valuation sits below the median, reflecting either a discount to stage-appropriate multiples or undervaluation relative to top-quartile peers. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peer cohorts, customer concentration in government contracting, and near-term funding environment conditions affecting Series C reception.
